name: irodori-rtf-spike
date: 2026-09-13 (updated: CoreML EP measurement, M4 Step B)
engine: IrodoriAdapter (ort 2.0.0-rc.13, CPU EP, Level3) — RF Euler loop in Rust, ported from irodori-tts-webgpu runtime/pipeline.mjs (bit-faithful reference, corr=1.0)

artifacts.weights: Irodori-TTS-500M-v3 (MIT, no-impersonation terms) + Semantic-DACVAE-Japanese-32dim codec (MIT) + llm-jp-3-150m tokenizer (Apache-2.0)

condition.reference_voice: SBV2 tsukuyomi output (11 s, 44.1 kHz -> resampled 48 kHz, LUFS -16) — same voice as the baseline engine

additional_scaling_points.note: fixed costs amortize with longer audio

cpu_steps_curve.note: Apple M1 Max, CPU EP, release, こんにちは (1.360 s audio), warm p50
cpu_steps_curve.fit: RTF ≈ 0.49 + 0.117 × steps (intercept ~0.49 = non-DiT cost: encode + duration + DAC decode)

coreml_ep.feature: musculus [coreml] = ort/coreml, ORT CoreML EP via ort 2.0.0-rc.13 (onnxruntime 1.28)
coreml_ep.environment: sandbox could not write CoreML’s default cache (~/Library/Caches); re-measured with MUSCULUS_COREML_CACHE_DIR inside the workspace — conclusions unchanged (session load 28 s with a writable cache)

sessions_rejected.text_encoder: Failed to build the model execution plan (error -14)
sessions_rejected.speaker_encoder: Failed to build the model execution plan (error -14)

mlprogram.verdict: no speedup — the DiT (80 of ~80 forwards) stays on CPU

neural_network_format.verdict: all graphs partition, but ~1.8x SLOWER than CPU EP and 28 s to load

numerical_fidelity.verdict: CoreML does not change the audio materially — the problem is purely performance

comparison.ratio: ~25x slower than SBV2 on CPU at 40 steps for short sentences; ~15x for long ones (fixed costs amortize); RTF scales linearly with steps
improvement_paths: fewer steps (20 steps -> ~2.6; quality must be re-measured)
CoreML EP (Apple GPU/ANE) — untested here, likely the biggest lever on this hardware
CFG already batch-1 outside the guidance window
comparison.realtime_verdict: CoreML is NOT the realtime lever for this model set: MLProgram cannot partition the DiT, NeuralNetwork partitions everything but runs slower than the CPU EP. On CPU, RTF ≈ 0.49 + 0.117 × steps, so RTF < 1.0 would need ≲ 4 steps, where flow-matching quality is doubtful. Realtime (RTF < 1) is therefore not reachable for Irodori-500M-v3 with the measured levers.
remaining_levers: fewer steps with a quality check (10 steps: RTF 1.66; 5 steps: 1.08) — needs listening/CER validation
fp16 ONNX exports (onnx_fp16/ in the artifact repo) — untested on CPU
Irodori v4.1-Small (own ONNX export required) — different size/latency, unknown
dual-engine posture: SBV2JE (RTF 0.199) for realtime, Irodori for batch quality

tolerance_policy.absolute: batch use: RTF < 6.0 at 40 steps (met: 5.16); realtime use: RTF < 1.0 (not met by any measured Irodori configuration — needs a different engine or model)

notes: Reference voice is the SBV2 baseline's own output, so the ear comparison (M4 protocol) runs on the same voice for both engines.
The reference runtime was verified bit-faithful vs PyTorch (corr = 1.000000).
